an5.200:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmaṃ manasikaroto kāmesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati na ppasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an5.200:1.4: nekkhammaṃ kho pan'assa manasikaroto nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
an5.200:1.5: Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sukataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ suvisaṃyuttaṃ kāmehi,
an5.200:1.6: ye ca kāmapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati.
an5.200:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno vyāpādaṃ manasikaroto vyāpāde cittaṃ na pakkhandati na ppasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an5.200:2.2: avyāpādaṃ kho pan'assa manasikaroto avyāpāde cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
an5.200:2.3: Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sukataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ suvisaṃyuttaṃ vyāpādena,
an5.200:2.4: ye ca vyāpādapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati.
an5.200:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno vihesaṃ manasikaroto vihesāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati na ppasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an5.200:3.2: avihesaṃ kho pan'assa manasikaroto avihesāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
an5.200:3.3: Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sukataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ suvisaṃyuttaṃ vihesāya,
an5.200:3.4: ye ca vihesāpaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati.
an5.200:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno rūpaṃ manasikaroto rūpe cittaṃ na pakkhandati na ppasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an5.200:4.2: arūpaṃ kho pan'assa manasikaroto arūpe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
an5.200:4.3: Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sukataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ suvisaṃyuttaṃ rūpehi,
an5.200:4.4: ye ca rūpapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati.
an5.200:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sakkāyaṃ manasikaroto sakkāye cittaṃ na pakkhandati na ppasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an5.200:5.2: sakkāyanirodhaṃ kho pan'assa manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
an5.200:5.3: Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sukataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ suvisaṃyuttaṃ sakkāyena,
an5.200:5.4: ye ca sakkāyapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati.
an5.200:6.1: Tassa kāmanandi pi nānuseti, vyāpādanandi pi nānuseti, vihesānandi pi nānuseti, rūpanandi pi nānuseti, sakkāyanandi pi nānuseti, so kāmanandiyā pi ananusayā vyāpādanandiyā pi ananusayā vihesānandiyā pi ananusayā rūpanandiyā pi ananusayā sakkāyanandiyā pi ananusayā
an5.200:6.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu niranusayo, acchejji taṇhaṃ, vivaṭṭayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammāmānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassa.
an5.200:6.3: Imā kho bhikkhave pañca nissaraṇīyā dhātuyo ti.
